recent_funding_views.implication: Remain at the zero official-SOFR benchmark. That is a front-loaded hike sequence of roughly 37.5bp into year-end 2026 and about 90bp by Sep27, so apparent funding-tightening or hawkish-repricing edges are the curve, not a mispricing of it. No unpriced residual versus those four contracts is identified in the frozen funding_context.
